title: Harness pin bump refused while dsh web runs
requirement: The kit must never replace the globally installed harness while a `dsh web` server is running: the live process keeps the composition it composed at boot while serving the new files, so the browser fails with "Failed to load plugins". A pin bump in that state is refused and reported, not applied.
reason: The check needs a real running `dsh web` process and a pin that differs from the installed harness; automating it would either install a different harness on the machine or require stubbing the process table and npm install, and a stubbed install would not prove the refusal (the whole point is that no install happens).
steps: Keep a `dsh web` server running (here :3080, pid 413264).
Create /tmp/kitguard/install.sh declaring a different DSH_VERSION pin (0.2.2-rc.4-guardproof) and a scratch home /tmp/guard-home.
Read the `harness.state` log line and confirm it is action=blocked with reason=web-server-running and the running pids.
expected: `kit-update --apply` with a pin that differs from the installed version exits 0, prints `harness.state action=blocked ... reason=web-server-running pids=...` and installs nothing; no npm install -g runs.

history.notes: Observed on this machine: the guard detected both the live :3080 server (413264) and the probe :3081 (422866) and installed nothing.

observation.output:
harness.installed have=0.2.2-rc.3 pin=0.2.2-rc.4-guardproof
kit.drift reason=harness-only actions=install-harness
warn: harness 0.2.2-rc.3 -> 0.2.2-rc.4-guardproof not installed: dsh web is running (pid 413264, 422866)
warn:   a harness replaced under a live server keeps that server's OLD composition while serving the NEW client bundles, so the next page load fails with "Failed to load plugins"
warn:   stop the web server, then re-run this convergence; the next launch installs the pin and composes the new rows
harness.state action=blocked have=0.2.2-rc.3 want=0.2.2-rc.4-guardproof reason=web-server-running pids=413264,422866
